issue.title: StoryInput context compaction｜移除 per-segment 重複 clip summary
issue.description:
<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> 在 <issue id="b50df54d-156e-4375-926e-b6e2258969f9" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-20/adaptive-sampling-rescue稀疏-clip-evidence-sufficiency">VID-20</issue> 合併後，兩支 Coffee formal Perception 均 PASS；Story generation 隨即在 <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> context preflight 正確 fail-closed。

## Authoritative blocker

* latest merged main: `49faa3f71e7cf6651072e0cd73ad2fa6c7ff9d23`
* isolated Coffee storyboard: 17 segments
* generation UUID: `1ef6b2fa-23c4-4bcf-ad8c-935f0672f180`
* provider/model: `local_text / gemma-4-12b-it`
* context capacity: 32,768 (`lmstudio.loaded_instance.contextLength`)
* reserved output: 2,048
* available input: 30,720
* estimated input: 175,850
* `request_allowed=false`, reason `estimated_input_exceeds_context`
* HTTP Story generation POST = 0

## Root cause to verify/fix

Current `build_story_input_snapshot()` builds `ai_summary_by_video` by joining every `frames.vision_summary` for a clip, then injects that clip-wide concatenated string into each segment as `ai_visual_summary`. For a clip with many perception frames/windows this repeats the same large clip summary once per segment, while `clips[]` also carries the clip summary. This creates N× redundant StoryInput growth unrelated to the actual 17-segment story planning need.

## Scope

1. Measure/audit StoryInput bytes by top-level section and per segment before changing behavior; prove the dominant duplication source.
2. StoryInput `segments[]` must use bounded segment-level perception/story evidence (segment visual summary/action/shot role/tags/quality/human override) rather than repeating the full clip-wide concatenation on every segment.
3. Clip-level context may remain in `clips[]`, but must be deterministic and bounded/aggregated; do not repeat raw/all frame summaries per segment.
4. Preserve all required semantics:
   * stable `segment_uuid` and exact ordering
   * user summary / human override priority
   * story profile / creator profile / project intent
   * must_keep / exclude guidance / desired sequence/pacing
   * audio effective state
   * StoryInput hash/stale semantics
5. Do not weaken <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> context preflight, falsify token estimates, increase/assume model context, switch cloud provider, or silently truncate mandatory human instructions.
6. If compaction must drop optional AI detail, make the policy explicit, deterministic, auditable, and prioritize human/user-authored fields over AI-derived redundant detail.
7. Cache/input hash must change when any retained story-relevant content changes, but not because removed duplicate representation changes independently.

## Regressions

* multi-segment same-clip input does not repeat identical clip-wide frame-summary blob per segment.
* segment-specific visual/action context remains distinct and preserved.
* human override/user summary/must_keep/exclude/desired sequence remain intact.
* deterministic repeat snapshot/hash.
* story-relevant segment change invalidates hash; irrelevant removed duplicate representation does not create false semantic divergence.
* large synthetic project shows payload growth approximately proportional to segment-level bounded evidence, not `segments × all-frame-summary`.
* <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> unknown/oversize context still fails before HTTP; sufficient compact request is allowed.

## Real acceptance

Use latest main + this branch, isolated real Coffee project.

* reuse/rerun formal Perception as needed; both clips must remain PASS.
* build 17-segment StoryInput and record before/after section byte audit.
* Story request must fit the real 32,768 context only if the actual compact request truly fits <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> preflight; no estimator bypass.
* if preflight PASS: actual local Story POST > 0, provider audit recorded, strict Story schema/validation PASS.
* then continue <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> through human review/Apply → approval → formal Render → Render Report/Final QC → Delivery QA → human final preview → `deliverable_ready`.
* if another authoritative gate fails, stop there with evidence; do not mark <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> / <issue id="0b064e3d-4d7f-4e8e-b57c-3c7b621c7716" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-11/真實流程驗收-round-1阻塞修正與產品硬化">VID-11</issue> Done.
* source SHA/size/mtime unchanged; production data/config unchanged.

Handoff: dedicated branch from latest `origin/main`, Draft PR, HEAD/tests/CI/real acceptance evidence in PR + Linear.

issue.title: Story Provider runtime context authority｜LM Studio loaded instance freshness
issue.description:
<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> 在 <issue id="8251d7ae-1d0a-4529-9a15-04f4ff587bec" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-21/storyinput-context-compaction移除-per-segment-重複-clip-summary">VID-21</issue> 合併後，17-segment Coffee StoryInput 已由 172,779 B 壓至 26,756 B，且 <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> preflight 在 configured/persisted 32,768 context 下 PASS；但正式 local Story POST 被 LM Studio 實際 JIT-loaded 8,192 context 擋下。此 child 修正 local Story Provider 對 runtime context capacity 的 authority/freshness，避免 stale config 讓 preflight 假通過。

## Authoritative baseline

* latest merged main: `894f2bce24b9e9e9686e547bca79ab0fb76c21cc`
* Story generation: `536b2cc1-8aa0-4a53-86a6-1b887036607a`
* provider/model: `local_text / gemma-4-12b-it`
* compact StoryInput: 17 segments / 26,756 B
* preflight metadata: context 32,768, reserved output 2,048, estimated input 29,719, `request_allowed=true`
* actual LM Studio loaded instance after JIT: `contextLength=8,192`
* actual prompt: 8,833 tokens; LM Studio `exceed_context_size_error`, HTTP 400
* Story schema/Apply/render flow not reached.

## Confirmed code root

Current `provider_from_config()` resolves context from `story.context_length` / persisted model metadata / `ai.local` once and passes it into `LocalTextStoryProvider`. `LocalTextStoryProvider.context_metadata()` only returns that stored `self.context_length`; it does not re-resolve the exact live endpoint/model loaded-instance state immediately before request. Therefore a previously recorded `lmstudio.loaded_instance.contextLength=32768` can remain authoritative even after JIT reload actually uses 8192.

## Scope

1. Separate `configured/requested context` from `runtime verified context`. For local LM Studio, runtime exact endpoint/model instance must be authoritative whenever available; stale config/model metadata must never override a contradictory live value.
2. Immediately before every Story HTTP attempt, including corrective retry, resolve/verify the target model's current runtime context capacity using a local-only, auditable provider path. Bind evidence to exact endpoint + model + loaded-instance identity/state where available.
3. If the exact model is currently loaded, use the verified loaded-instance context for <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> preflight. Example: config 32768 + live 8192 => preflight must use 8192 and block before Story generation POST.
4. If the model is not loaded and actual JIT context cannot be known safely before generation, do not assume config capacity. Either:
   * use an existing provider-supported deterministic local ensure/load path only if it can be explicit, auditable, bounded, and does not download models or mutate persistent config; then re-query the loaded instance and preflight again; or
   * fail closed before Story POST with `runtime_context_unverified` / equivalent actionable evidence.
     Do not silently change context, cloud-switch, or use a paid provider.
5. Any runtime load/reload/ensure transition must be followed by a fresh exact-binding context query before request. Cached context evidence must not survive a loaded-instance change unless identity/fingerprint proves it is still the same runtime state.
6. Preserve <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> exact request-message budgeting and fail-closed behavior. Do not falsify token estimates or lower reserved output solely to pass acceptance.
7. Improve provider audit/error mapping: if an endpoint still returns context-overflow, record actual provider reason/runtime metadata rather than only generic `HTTP 400 / local model unavailable`; no blind retry.
8. Doctor Story context reporting and generation-time Story context must share the same authority semantics so Doctor cannot say 32768 while generation actually runs against an 8192 instance.

## Regressions

* stale config 32768 + exact live instance 8192 => effective context 8192; oversize request blocked before generation POST.
* live exact instance 32768 + compact request within budget => preflight PASS.
* model/endpoint mismatch cannot reuse another instance's context evidence.
* unloaded/unknown runtime state cannot be treated as known capacity unless an explicit verified ensure/load step succeeds.
* runtime reload from 32768 to 8192 invalidates prior evidence.
* every HTTP attempt/retry revalidates runtime context.
* public/non-loopback endpoint remains blocked; no cloud fallback/model download/persistent config mutation.
* context-overflow HTTP response is classified/audited explicitly if it occurs.
* <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> unknown/oversize tests remain 0 HTTP.

## Real Coffee acceptance

Use latest main + this branch in isolated Coffee workspace.

* Doctor --full must report the same authoritative runtime Story context semantics used by generation.
* two formal Perception clips remain PASS.
* build same 17-segment compact StoryInput.
* verify exact live `gemma-4-12b-it` runtime capacity before Story POST.
* if live capacity is insufficient, formal generation must stop before POST with explicit runtime context evidence; do not fake pass.
* if an explicit/safe local runtime ensure/load policy yields sufficient verified capacity, rerun <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> preflight and only then send Story POST; strict Story schema/validation must PASS.
* after Story PASS, continue <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> through human review/Apply → approval → formal Render → Render Report/Final QC → Delivery QA → human final preview → `deliverable_ready`.
* stop at the next authoritative blocker with evidence; do not mark <issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> / <issue id="0b064e3d-4d7f-4e8e-b57c-3c7b621c7716" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-11/真實流程驗收-round-1阻塞修正與產品硬化">VID-11</issue> Done early.
* source SHA/size/mtime and production data/config unchanged.

Handoff: dedicated branch from latest `origin/main`, Draft PR, HEAD/tests/CI/real acceptance evidence in PR + Linear.

issue.title: Story runtime context provisioning｜安全建立足夠 context 的 LM Studio instance
issue.description:
<issue id="9e29bba9-7eef-4def-a7cd-bab447d02eb2" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-18/round-1-最終真實流程驗收重跑deliverable-ready-dod">VID-18</issue> 在 <issue id="8e45c876-4361-41ea-a2e1-858fffdbd076" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-22/story-provider-runtime-context-authoritylm-studio-loaded-instance">VID-22</issue> 合併後已能正確以 exact live LM Studio loaded-instance context 做 fail-closed preflight。現在的第一個 authoritative blocker 不再是 metadata freshness，而是 Story model 實際只載入 8,192 context，無法容納 compact 17-segment Story request。

## Authoritative baseline

* latest merged main: `17697bffb457b07cdb75d57914c3edfa1d45616f`
* provider/model: `local_text / gemma-4-12b-it`
* compact StoryInput: 17 segments / 26,756 B
* <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue> estimate: input 29,719 / reserved output 2,048 / required request budget 31,767
* exact live Story instance: 8,192 context / 6,144 available input
* formal generation `686b2b41-cb38-45d1-8cc4-db1c31c50b48` correctly blocks before generation POST, calls=0
* configured 32,768 is now audit/request intent only, not authoritative runtime capacity

## Goal

Add a deterministic, explicit, auditable local runtime provisioning path that can use the already-installed Story model with sufficient context without lying to <issue id="6d7b98d0-7825-4f59-8813-8e8683afc63c" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-13/story-providercontext-budget-preflight-與可解釋失敗">VID-13</issue>, downloading models, mutating persistent LM Studio/app config, switching cloud, or silently destroying an externally-owned loaded instance.

## Scope

 1. Keep <issue id="8e45c876-4361-41ea-a2e1-858fffdbd076" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-22/story-provider-runtime-context-authoritylm-studio-loaded-instance">VID-22</issue> authority intact: configured/requested context is never treated as effective until a fresh exact loaded-instance query verifies it.
 2. Define a Story runtime context target from the real request budget and configured policy. For current Coffee, the target must be >= 31,767; 32,768 is the existing requested target. Never lower reserved output or token estimate merely to pass.
 3. Use an official LM Studio local runtime mechanism to provision an already-installed model instance with an explicit context length. Preferred path: native v1 model load with `context_length` and auditable returned load config/instance identity. No model download.
 4. Do not silently unload, resize, or replace an unrelated/external loaded instance. issue.title: AI Editor UX v1｜Simple-first Creative Flow、Style Preview、Timeline Inspector
issue.description:
## 定位

把 Video Vault AI 從「功能都有，但使用者需要理解很多 contract / 參數」改成真正的 AI 剪片助手體驗：

**AI 先提出可直接採用的結果 → 使用者看 Preview → 不滿意才展開詳細設定。**

後端仍維持 Creative Brief、Visual Style、Title Style、Render、approval、provenance 等正式 contract；前端不要把後端複雜度等比例攤給使用者。

參考 `chang416/cutcraft` 的 agent workflow / editorial UX 概念，但維持 Video Vault AI 現有 WebUI-first、persistent state、Perception、Story、approval、Render、Final QC、Delivery QA 架構；不引入 CutCraft runtime，不直接搬程式碼。

## UX 第一原則：Simple-first / Progressive Disclosure

一般使用者主流程只需要看到少數高價值決策：

1. 輸出方向：橫向 16:9 / 直向 9:16，AI 標示推薦與理由。
2. 真實素材視覺 Preview：Recommended / Diary Natural、Clean Minimal、Cinematic。
3. 一個明確的「採用推薦」或「確認並開始剪輯」。

其餘設定預設收起：

* framing strategy
* title typography / position / readability / motion
* grading/LUT 細節
* subtitle/caption 細節
* renderer/capability/provenance 技術資訊

只有使用者主動點「詳細設定 / 微調」才展開，而且詳細設定應分組、accordion 化，不一次把全部控制項攤開。

UI 應使用人話，例如「裁切填滿 / 模糊背景補齊 / 保留完整畫面」，而不是要求一般使用者理解內部 strategy ID。

## Scope / children

1. Creative Brief：後端 contract 已完成；UI 要整合進 Simple-first creative flow。
2. Visual Style Preview：後端與 Preview/Render parity 已完成；UI 要改成 preview-first，而不是 control-first。
3. Simple-first Editor UX 重構：新增 child，先完成 progressive disclosure，再往後增加功能。
4. Timeline Inspector：保留 drill-down 功能，但必須在簡化後的資訊架構上加入，不能讓主畫面重新變密集。
5. Editorial Policy：在 UX v1 穩定後再進行。

## 字幕範圍邊界

字幕審核、中文字型、字幕樣式/編輯能力會由獨立字幕任務處理。

本 epic 只定義 UX 邊界：

* 字幕詳細控制預設收在 Advanced。
* 主流程最多顯示字幕是否啟用與一個可理解的 style summary / preview。
* 不在 Simple-first UX 任務重新設計字幕 engine、font registry、caption review workflow。

## Persistence / safety

* Simple UI 與 Advanced UI 必須操作同一份 persisted semantic contract，不可有兩套 source of truth。
* 「採用 AI 推薦」必須等同於 materialize + human approval 正式 contract，不是前端快捷假動作。
* Advanced 修改後必須讓既有 preview evidence 正確 stale / regenerate。
* 不弱化既有 approval / fail-closed / provenance / QA 契約。
* 不改動 source media。

## Horizontal Extensibility Contract

這裡有理論上可以水平增加的東西：未來還會加入 audio、BGM、字幕、transition、editorial policy、Timeline drill-down 等設定區塊。

因此 Simple-first UI 第一版必須留下最小 extensibility contract：

* stable section/control IDs
* simple / advanced disclosure level metadata
* summary renderer metadata
* human label 與 internal ID 分離
* capability / enabled / unavailable 狀態
* deterministic ordering

新增 sibling setting section 不應要求重寫主流程 component 的大型 special-case branch。

不要求建立通用 plugin framework；metadata registry / schema + synthetic sibling fixture 即可。

## DoD

至少以 Coffee 真實 project 驗證：

* 首屏不再同時出現大量 select / technical options。
* 一般路徑可在 3 個主要決策內完成：方向 → style preview → 確認。
* AI recommendation 可一鍵採用，但不跳過 human preview / approval gate。
* Advanced 預設關閉，重新整理後 disclosure state 可採合理產品策略，但 persisted semantic values 不遺失。
* 使用者可從 summary 看懂目前設定，例如：`16:9 · Diary Natural · 直向素材自動補背景 · Overlay 字卡`。
* Advanced 修改會更新 summary 並要求重新 Preview；不 stale Story/Perception 等不相關 semantic state。
* Timeline Inspector 後續可加入而不重新把主畫面變成控制面板。
* 新增一個 synthetic setting section 可透過同一 disclosure metadata mechanism 出現在 Advanced / summary，不需主流程 special-case。

issue.description:
## 目標

在 Story / final render 前，用專案真實 frame 產生可比較的視覺方案，讓使用者看圖決定，而不是只讀「簡約 / 電影感 / 活潑」等抽象文字。

## MVP

由 approved Creative Brief + representative project frames 產生至少 3 個 deterministic preview variants：

1. Recommended / Diary Natural
2. Clean Minimal
3. Cinematic

依功能是否啟用，preview 可呈現：

* subtitle / caption font、size、position、background、安全區
* grading / color mood preview
* chapter card / title treatment
* overlay/effect intensity 的代表性畫面
* aspect ratio / reframing safe-zone

BGM mood 先以 metadata / sample selection 表示，不要求在此任務建立新的音樂生成系統。

## Contract

* Preview 必須由真實 source/proxy frame 產生並記錄 source segment/frame provenance。
* 每個 variant 有穩定 ID、settings hash、creative brief revision binding。
* 使用者核准某個 variant 或局部修改後，保存為 approved visual style state。
* Creative Brief revision 改變時，舊 preview / approval 必須可辨識 stale。
* Render 使用 approved values；不得在 render 階段重新隨機決定 style。
* Preview failure 不得污染既有 approved state。

## Acceptance

* Coffee project：三套 preview 能明顯區分，且 Recommended 可一鍵核准。
* Travel project：修改字幕位置或 grading intent 後重新 preview，只 invalidates 受影響的 style state。
* refresh / restart 後 preview metadata、approval、provenance 一致。
* preview 與 final render 的字幕位置 / style settings 可被自動比對，避免「預覽一套、輸出另一套」。
* 無 source mutation；不新增未授權字型 / LUT / asset。

### Extensibility contract — future title/card additions must follow one registry/schema

Human requirement: VID-27 must leave a clear, enforceable path for adding new title/card styles later. Future additions must not require ad-hoc renderer branches or one-off FFmpeg strings.

## 1. Separate semantic role from visual preset

Title/card data must distinguish:

- semantic role, e.g. `chapter_title`, `section_title`, `location_title`, `date_time_title`, `lower_third`, `caption`
- visual preset / treatment, e.g. `diary_natural_overlay`, `clean_minimal_overlay`, `cinematic_overlay`, `standalone_card`

A new style should normally be added by registering a new preset against supported roles, not by creating a new renderer code path.

## 2. Versioned schema

Create a versioned title-style contract with stable fields for:

- preset ID + preset version
- supported roles
- typography tokens
- palette tokens
- layout / anchors / safe-zone rules
- readability treatment
- overlay vs standalone composition
- motion preset + timing/easing
- responsive 16:9 / 9:16 rules
- asset/font requirements
- renderer capability requirements

Unknown required fields / unsupported preset versions must fail closed or produce an explicit migration/unsupported state; never silently downgrade to a generic style.

## 3. Registry-driven design

Use a central `TitleStyleRegistry` / equivalent source of truth that can:

- register preset metadata
- validate schema
- list supported roles/aspects
- resolve semantic tokens into renderer-ready values
- expose preview metadata to WebUI
- expose compatibility/capability status

Preview and final Render must resolve through the same registry.

Do not scatter preset IDs, colors, font sizes or FFmpeg expressions across UI/API/renderer modules.

## 4. Inheritance / composition

Support controlled inheritance so new presets can reuse stable foundations without copying every field. Example:

`diary_natural_overlay_v2` may inherit base typography/safe-zone behavior and override palette/motion.

Inheritance must be resolved deterministically into a fully materialized approved style snapshot before render. Runtime must not depend on mutable parent preset definitions after approval.

## 5. Approved snapshot semantics

When a user approves a visual style, persist the fully resolved semantic style values plus:

- preset ID/version
- registry/schema version
- resolved token hash
- font/asset identity

This prevents an app update that changes a preset from silently changing an already-approved project.

If preset defaults later change, existing approved projects keep their resolved approved values until the user explicitly refreshes/re-approves.

## 6. Adding a new title/card preset

A future preset should require a predictable checklist only:

1. define stable preset ID/version
2. declare supported semantic roles
3. define typography/layout/palette/readability/motion tokens
4. define 16:9 and 9:16 responsive rules
5. declare required fonts/assets/capabilities
6. add deterministic preview fixtures
7. add registry validation tests
8. add preview ↔ render parity test
9. add migration/compatibility behavior if replacing an older preset
10. add human-visible preset name/description separately from stable internal ID

It should NOT require editing unrelated Story/Perception logic.

## 7. New semantic role rules

Adding an entirely new role (for example `product_callout` or `quote_card`) requires:

- explicit role schema
- allowed content fields
- layout/safe-zone behavior
- accessibility/readability constraints
- supported preset matrix
- preview fixture
- render parity test

Do not let arbitrary unknown role names fall through to `chapter_title` styling.

## 8. Quality gates for every new preset

Each new preset must pass at minimum:

- bright background readability
- dark/complex background readability
- Traditional Chinese
- English
- mixed CJK/Latin
- long title wrapping
- short title
- 16:9
- 9:16
- overlay safe-zone
- missing preferred font fallback
- deterministic preview/render equivalence
- no clipping / no missing glyph boxes

Motion-enabled presets also need a short animated regression sample.

## 9. Capability degradation

If a preset asks for an effect unsupported by the current renderer/platform:

- declare capability mismatch explicitly
- either use a versioned documented fallback preset/treatment or fail closed
- audit the actual resolved treatment

Never silently omit shadow/background/motion/etc. while still reporting the original preset as rendered.

## 10. Custom/user-defined styles — future-ready boundary

Round-1 does not need a full custom style editor, but schema should allow future user-defined presets to be stored as versioned resolved token sets derived from the same contract.

Future custom presets must not inject raw arbitrary FFmpeg/filter command strings into the render path.

## Acceptance addition

VID-27 is not complete unless the implementation demonstrates that one additional synthetic/new title preset can be registered and previewed/rendered through the same registry without modifying core Story logic or adding a special-case render branch.

### Visual quality expansion — Title Design System / high-quality title treatment

Human feedback: chapter/title treatment should not stop at “text exists”. VID-27 must treat titles as a small deterministic design system so final output has intentional typography, color, hierarchy and motion quality.

## 1. Default treatment

For diary/travel/coffee projects, default chapter/title treatment should be **overlay on continuing footage**, not a standalone full-screen card.

Standalone chapter card remains an explicit optional variant only when:
- human selects it, or
- the visual style intentionally calls for a scene break.

VID-32 black-frame correctness remains valid, but standalone cards are no longer the recommended Coffee default.

## 2. Title hierarchy

Support at least these semantic roles:

- `chapter_title`
- `section_title`
- `location_title`
- `date_time_title`
- `lower_third`
- `caption/subtitle`

Each role must map to deterministic style tokens rather than one generic text preset.

Title style tokens should include at minimum:

- font family / fallback chain
- weight
- size / responsive scale
- line height
- letter spacing
- alignment
- max width / wrapping policy
- position / anchor
- safe-area margins
- text color
- accent color
- background treatment
- outline / shadow / glow (if enabled)
- corner radius / padding for boxes
- opacity
- entrance / exit motion
- duration / hold timing

Do not bundle arbitrary FFmpeg strings as the source of truth; persist semantic style values and resolve them in renderer.

## 3. Quality presets

The existing three preview families remain, but title treatments must be genuinely distinct rather than only changing font size:

### Recommended / Diary Natural
- restrained typography
- overlay over footage
- soft/high-readability treatment
- minimal motion
- warm/neutral accent derived from approved visual palette
- should feel like a personal diary, not advertising

### Clean Minimal
- high whitespace discipline
- simple sans-serif treatment
- strong hierarchy
- little/no decorative effect
- clean boxed or subtle shadow readability aid

### Cinematic
- more deliberate spacing and placement
- stronger title hierarchy
- restrained cinematic motion
- may use uppercase/small-title treatment where language permits
- no exaggerated trailer-style effects by default

## 4. Color system

Titles should use semantic palette tokens, not ad-hoc hard-coded colors per shot:

- `text_primary`
- `text_secondary`
- `accent`
- `surface_overlay`
- `surface_overlay_strong`
- `shadow`

Each Visual Style variant owns a palette.

Preview must show exact resolved colors.

Optional deterministic adaptive readability may inspect the representative frame behind the title and choose between approved light/dark text variants, but:
- it must stay inside the approved palette
- decision must be deterministic/auditable
- render must use the same resolved decision as preview
- no random per-frame styling

## 5. Readability / contrast

Title treatment must remain readable over real footage.

At minimum support deterministic readability aids:
- subtle shadow
- outline/stroke
- translucent background/gradient surface
- local dark/light overlay behind title region

Do not globally darken the entire frame just to make a small title readable unless the selected style explicitly asks for it.

Preview should include at least one bright and one dark/complex Coffee frame so we do not approve a title style that only works on one background.

## 6. Position / composition

Use safe-zone-aware anchors such as:
- top-left
- top-center
- bottom-left
- bottom-center
- center

Default placement should avoid covering the detected/known primary subject where practical.

VID-27 does not need a full tracking system, but representative preview should allow manual position override and preserve that approved value.

16:9 and 9:16 must have separate responsive layout rules; do not reuse raw pixel offsets from landscape in portrait.

## 7. Motion quality

Support a small controlled set of deterministic title motions, e.g.:
- fade
- fade + slight rise
- slide/fade
- scale/fade (very subtle)
- none

Expose duration/easing as semantic presets. Avoid flashy/random transitions.

Preview should include a short animated sample where technically practical; static frame preview alone is insufficient to judge title motion.

## 8. Chinese / English / Japanese text resilience

The title system must handle mixed Traditional Chinese / English / Japanese safely:
- deterministic fallback font chain
- no missing glyph boxes
- wrapping and line-height remain valid
- no unauthorized bundled font assets

Use only fonts/assets already allowed by the project/system, and audit the resolved font identity in preview/render metadata.

## 9. Preview UX

For each style variant, show real project footage with:
- chapter title
- lower-third/location example
- subtitle/caption example if enabled
- grading/LUT applied
- chosen framing treatment applied
- exact title palette and typography metadata

Allow human to:
- approve whole variant
- change title family/weight/size
- change accent/text palette within allowed options
- choose overlay vs standalone
- change position
- change readability aid
- change motion preset

Partial changes should invalidate only affected visual-style state.

## 10. Preview ↔ Render contract

Approved title design must become a versioned `title_style` / visual-style contract bound to the approved visual-style revision.

Final Render Report must expose enough evidence to compare:
- title role
- resolved font/fallback identity
- typography tokens
- palette tokens / resolved colors
- position/safe-zone
- background/readability treatment
- motion preset/timing
- overlay vs standalone treatment

Preview and final render must resolve from the same semantic contract; no “preview looks good but render uses another preset”.

## 11. Round-1 Coffee acceptance

At minimum generate Coffee previews that make these visibly comparable:

A. Diary Natural overlay — recommended
B. Clean Minimal overlay
C. Cinematic overlay
D. optional standalone card comparison

Use real Coffee frame(s), with the expected LUT/grading actually applied.

Human must be able to select a title treatment before the next full VID-18 render.

Quality bar: the preview should look like a deliberate finished title design, not a debugging label or generic drawtext sample.

### VID-18 human-preview concrete feedback

這次 Coffee final human preview 提供了兩個可直接作為 Visual Style Preview / final render acceptance 的具體要求：

1. **LUT / grading 必須實際套用**
   - 目前 final output 明顯是未套預期 LUT 的畫面，不可接受為最終 visual treatment。
   - Preview 必須能用真實 Coffee frame 顯示「未套 / 套用 approved LUT/grading」差異，並在 final Render Report audit 實際使用的 LUT/grading identity。
   - 不得只保存 `color mood` 文字卻在 Render 階段完全沒套 transform。

2. **chapter/title treatment 預設改成疊在原始畫面上**
   - 目前獨立切一張 chapter card 的呈現讓使用者覺得突兀。
   - Coffee diary 的 Recommended treatment 應優先採用 overlay title：文字直接疊在當下影片畫面，保留 footage continuity；只有 human 明確選擇 standalone card 時才切獨立畫面。
   - Preview variant 必須讓使用者直接比較 overlay vs standalone，而不是等 final render 才發現。

這兩點是 human feedback，不代表 VID-32 黑畫面修正回歸；VID-32 解的是 QA correctness，而這裡是 visual treatment / UX。

Round-1 目前 first correctness blocker 仍是 VID-39 display geometry。不要在 VID-39 PR 混入 LUT / title UX；geometry 修好後再以 VID-27 / focused visual-treatment work 接續。

issue.description:
## 目標

在 WebUI 提供 segment / ambiguous edit point 的視覺化 drill-down，不建立完整 NLE timeline，而是讓使用者與 Story/editorial logic 能快速確認「這裡為什麼切、畫面前後發生什麼、聲音是否連續」。

**執行順序調整：先完成** <issue id="18a7a130-9a21-4265-98f6-e35bcf672ac8" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-40/simple-first-editor-uxprogressive-disclosure-與三步創意流程">VID-40</issue> **Simple-first Editor UX，再開始本任務。** Timeline Inspector 應作為需要時才進入的 drill-down，不可重新把主 creative flow 變成密集控制面板。

設計參考 CutCraft `timeline_view.py` 的 filmstrip + waveform 概念，但資料層直接使用 Video Vault AI 已有 Perception / audio evidence / storyboard / source fingerprint。

## Simple-first integration

* 主流程只顯示「查看剪輯細節 / Inspector」入口與必要 warning / ambiguity summary。
* filmstrip、waveform、confidence、source/provenance 等資訊只在使用者 drill-down 後載入。
* 不在 creative-flow 首屏常駐完整 Inspector。
* Inspector 自身仍可有 overview → detailed evidence 的 progressive disclosure。

## MVP UI

針對單一 segment 或指定時間範圍顯示：

* evenly sampled filmstrip frames + timestamps
* audio waveform / silence ranges
* dialogue / ambience / detected audio events（有 evidence 才顯示）
* perception segment summary / action / shot role / confidence
* scene boundaries / hard gaps
* current cut-in / cut-out
* source clip identity與 output/story segment UUID

可由 Storyboard / review 畫面點擊進入，不要求使用者拖拉完整 timeline。

## Performance / provenance

* inspection frame/proxy 必須 cache，禁止每次 API request 對大型 source 重算 full hash。
* reuse 現有 source fingerprint contract；source 變更要正確 invalidate。
* 所有 frame / waveform / evidence 能追溯至 immutable source 與 generation。
* 長影片只做 on-demand range drill-down，不在背景對所有 segment 預生成高成本 composite。
* Windows long path、concurrent requests、stale project revision 要有明確處理。

## Editing integration

MVP 先允許檢視與精準輸入 cut-in / cut-out adjustment；變更後走既有 project revision / approval invalidation 契約，不直接繞過 Story / review。

後續才考慮拖拉 handle、J/L cut 或更完整 timeline editing，本任務不擴張成 NLE。

## Horizontal Extensibility Contract

這裡有理論上可水平增加的 evidence lane / inspector panel，例如 waveform、speech、perception、scene boundary、future motion/face/subject tracking。

第一版必須留下 stable lane/panel ID、versioned metadata、capability/availability、order、cache/provenance identity 與 synthetic sibling fixture；不要求大型 plugin framework。

## Acceptance

* Coffee：可從 storyboard 任一 segment 打開 inspector，filmstrip / waveform / perception evidence 與 source time range 對得上。
* Travel：至少驗證 scene boundary、環境音與較長移動鏡頭的 on-demand drill-down。
* 2GB+ source 重複開同一 range 時不重做 full-file hash；cache hit 可稽核。
* 修改 cut boundary 後 project revision 前進、既有 approval 正確 invalidated，source 不變。
* frontend refresh / server restart 後 inspector 仍能從 persistent project state 重建。
* 不破壞 <issue id="18a7a130-9a21-4265-98f6-e35bcf672ac8" href="https://linear.app/videoai/issue/VID-40/simple-first-editor-uxprogressive-disclosure-與三步創意流程">VID-40</issue> 的 Simple-first 主流程；Inspector 預設不佔 creative-flow 首屏主要空間。
